assets.subject: Independent retained rocket sled mount-skin concept
assets.prompt: Create one ORIGINAL stylized fantasy game vehicle concept from generic practical function alone, with no visual references: a compact snowless hover-sled with one secure EMPTY rider seat, simple reachable hand grips, and self-contained rocket propulsion integrated at the rear. The engine is OFF: no exhaust, smoke, flame or glow. Clear SIDE VIEW facing left, entire vehicle including nose, tail, grips and seat in frame with generous margins on perfectly plain white background, no cast shadow. Hand-painted fantasy concept with practical readable construction for a future 3D artist. No rider, people, landscape, unrelated objects, lettering, numerals, emblems, logos, watermark, border or dimensions. Do not imitate any existing game or artist.
assets.status: 2D concept for review; existing entitlement can be worn, fresh acquisition unverified; no 3D model
validation_needed: Review the sleek modern silhouette against the existing goblin-themed identity and Whetstorm art direction
Seat, grips, rider pose and clipping
Hover motion, ground clearance and scale
